t: Magnusson extra fine 400 grit hand sanding sheets are designed for high-quality surface preparation and material removal. Suitable for professional joiners and metalworkers, the pack of 4 sheets is ideal for achieving smooth finishes on wood and metal surfaces. Constructed from sharp silicon carbide abrasive on a durable, water-resistant latex paper backing, the sheets perform exceptionally well for both wet and dry applications. Measuring 280mm by 230mm, they provide a durable, water-resistant option that resists clogging and ensures a consistent, professional finish before painting or priming.
b: Large Sheets Ensure Wide Coverage for Fast Material Removal
Extra Fine Grit Prepares Surfaces for Finishing
